dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures along the lateral flank exhibit sharp, high-contrast boundaries (low pixel intensity) that transition abruptly to high-intensity (lighter) interior regions. The perimeters are irregular and range from closed circles to fragmented arcs.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid low-intensity pixel clusters is visible on the dorsal ridge and neck area; these blobs lack internal gradients and are clustered more tightly than the macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct lateral 'O' structures form a scalene triangle, with the anterior-most segment aligned approximately 30 degrees from the dorsal-ventral axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-frequency dark speckling localized on the visible pectoral flipper, creating a texture significantly finer than the macro-annuli patterns on the main torso.
